outcome: maternal complications (gestational hypertension, polyhydramnios, preterm labor, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 400 antenatal women attending an outpatient department at a tertiary care center
finding: The incidence of GDM was 5.2% using the DIPSI method, and there was a significant correlation between GDM and developing pregnancy complications like gestational hypertension, polyhydramnios, preterm labor, and postpartum hemorrhage.
